- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nebuta Matsuri is held in Aomori in August.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Takayama Matsuri is held in Hida Takayama during April and October.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sapporo Snow Festival is held in Hokkaido during February.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tanabata Matsuri is held in various locations on July 7th.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yuki Matsuri is held in Hokkaido in February.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jidai Matsuri (Festival of the Ages) is held in Kyoto in October.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provides tips to fully enjoy the Gion Matsuri experience, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Plan ahead and book accommodations and transport well in advance.
